question: How many silver medals was won by India in Tokyo Paralympic 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**8.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• India won a total of **19 medals **in the Tokyo Paralympic 2020, out of which **5 were gold, 8 were silver, and 6 were bronze.**
 
• India's performance in the Tokyo Paralympic 2020 was historic as it was their **best-ever performance** in the Paralympic games.
